CBosses

Every boss in the plugin as it is built in game: block models with their own attacks, entrance and death. Drag to turn the camera, scroll or pinch to zoom. Pick a boss, then press Entrance, Death or any attack. Flying bosses flap, the egg really hatches, and deaths shatter into shards. Every piece wears its real vanilla block texture, so what you see here is what spawns in game. The Decor group at the bottom has the face-pulling pumpkins.
